_comment: Copy this file to data/positions.local.json and enter your focused watchlist. positions.local.json is gitignored and is never committed. Use fundTicker when the WAGN symbol differs from the display/Yahoo symbol (for example CSU CN vs CSU.TO). entry: null avoids a made-up cost basis; nextReport: null avoids a stale date. If this example is used, the page visibly labels it DEMO.
